transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I came in because lately, over the past few months, I just can’t keep my mind on one thing. I’m driving and every CB chirp, fuel price sign, or random idea pulls me off track. I’ve been missing details I normally wouldn’t—like a client’s delivery note, or forgetting who I said I’d call back. It’s not like me, and it finally got to the point where I figured I should talk to someone.
When you were a child, did you also have a hard time staying focused?

I’m not really sure. I mean, I got through school okay from what I remember. I don’t think anybody made a big issue of me not paying attention as a kid, but it’s been a long time, so I can’t say for sure.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot, even when there isn’t a clear reason to?
Not really, no. I mean, I worry about normal stuff—work, bills, keeping up with things—but I wouldn’t say I’m sitting around anxious for no reason.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
I don’t think so. I mean, I get frustrated with how scattered I’ve been, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been feeling depressed or really down lately.
Before these concentration problems started, did you have a head injury?
No, I don’t think so. I can’t remember any head injury before this started.
Have other people who know you well noticed that your memory or concentration has gotten worse?

Yeah, they have. My wife’s mentioned it, and even people at work have noticed. What got me to come in is my mind keeps jumping all over the place—every CB chirp, a fuel price sign, some new idea—and then I miss stuff I normally wouldn’t. Like a delivery note for a client, or who I said I’d call back. It’s not like me.
Besides getting distracted, have you been having trouble remembering recent conversations or events?

Not really. I mean, I might forget something if I wasn’t paying attention in the first place, but I haven’t noticed myself forgetting whole conversations or events. It’s more like my mind wasn’t on it.
Have you been diagnosed with any medical or neurologic condition around the time these attention problems began?
No, not that I know of. I wasn’t diagnosed with anything medical or neurological when this started.
Have you ever been told you have any disease or problem affecting your brain?
No, I don’t think so. Nobody’s ever told me I had a brain problem or anything like that.
Before the past few months, had you been this easily distracted for most of your life?

No, not for most of my life. I mean, I’ve always been able to do my routes and keep track of things fine. It’s really been these last few months that my mind keeps jumping to every CB chirp, fuel price sign, or some new idea, and then I miss details I normally wouldn’t, like a delivery note or who I told I’d call back.
